onboarding.name: First-run guide
onboarding.description: On a new collection: asks what you study and sets up a deck with the right classification (CEFR levels, YKS sections…), plus small starter decks.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Flashcard
onboarding.intro: Four short steps to get going; each one does the real thing. Skip whenever you like.
onboarding.starters_none: No starter deck for this subject; the app guide is always offered.
onboarding.done: Ready: {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} added. Undo removes the whole setup.
onboarding.starters_hint: “Start with a ready deck” adds these. Starting with your own words sets up an empty deck.

guide.title: Getting started
guide.all_done: All done! You can reopen the guide from Help.
guide.add_hint: Type the word, its meaning and an example sentence, e.g. “resilient → dayanıklı”.
guide.add_setup_hint: Pick what you study and we set up your deck.
guide.study_hint: Cards come one by one: think of the answer, flip, say whether you knew it.
guide.where: Where today’s cards and your progress live
guide.home_hint: Home shows the cards due today.
guide.stats_hint: Progress shows how much you learned, day by day.
guide.extension_hint: Save a word with its subtitle sentence in one click while you watch.

starters.heading: Starter decks
starters.intro: Small decks written for this app, in Turkish and English. They become ordinary decks you can change or delete.
starters.installed: Added “{name}” ({count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}).

onboarding.apply: Set up from the first-run guide
